verses.text: Ay jun k'ual ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal t'a chonhab' Keila, ix elk'ajb'at strigo heb' toto wal ix stek'eli, yuj chi' ayik ix yalan jun tik heb' t'a winhaj David,

ix b'at sk'anb'an yab' winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tzam in a chab'at wak' owal yet' juntzanh filisteo chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová: --Ixik ak' owal, tza kolankanel chonhab' Keila tik, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo heb' winh ajun yet' winhaj David chi', ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Ina to t'a xiwk'olal ayonhek' t'a Judá tik, okxom wal to tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a chonhab' Keila, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ejxi winh t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wixi t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ixik t'a chonhab' Keila chi'. Ha in ol wak'och heb' filisteo chi' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok t'a chonhab' Keila chi'. Hata' ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb', yuj chi' ix yik'kanek' smolb'etzal nok' heb' smasanil. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkanel heb' kajan t'a Keila chi'.
Ha winhaj Abiatar yuninal winhaj Ahimelec, winh ix el lemnajok, ix k'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj David t'a chonhab' Keila chi', yet'nak jun chaleka winh.

Ix alchaj t'a winhaj Saúl to ha t'a chonhab' Keila ayek' winhaj David chi'. Ix snaan winh icha tik: Ha tiknaik toxo ix ak'jioch winhaj David chi' t'a yol in k'ab' yuj Dios, yujto toxo ix b'at smakb'ejkanoch sb'a winh t'a yol jun chonhab' to te wach' yajoch spuertail smakchaji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtan masanil heb' soldado winh, yik sb'at oymitaj winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a Keila yuj heb' yalani.
Palta ix yojtakejel winhaj David chi' to wan skot winhaj Saúl yak' owal yet' winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj sakerdote Abiatar to syik'kot k'apak chaleka winh yik sk'anb'ej heb' t'a Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, a in a chekab' in tik ix wab'i to a winhaj Saúl wan snaan winh ul satel chonhab' Keila tik wuuj.

¿Ol am jawok winh icha ix aj wab'ani? ¿Ol am in yak'och heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Keila tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh? Tzin tewi t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, to tzal t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yalan Jehová chi': --Ha winhaj Saúl chi' wan skot winh, xchi.

Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová chi': --¿Ol am in yak'och heb' aj chonhab' Keila tik yet' heb' in soldado t'a yol sk'ab' winh? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi Jehová chi': --I', ol ex yak'och heb', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix el winhaj David yet' heb' soldado chi', ay am junok 600 heb'. Ch'okch'ok b'aj ayek' heb' t'a juntak el. Ayik ix k'ochxi yab'ixal t'a winhaj Saúl chi' to toxo ix el heb' t'a chonhab' Keila chi', majxo b'atlaj winh ta'.

Yuj chi' ix aj winhaj David chi' t'a juntzanh k'een nhak'een t'a sikil lu'um t'a yol yik Zif. Wach'chom ix saychajek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a junjun k'u, palta maj ak'jilaj winh yuj Dios t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an spekal winhaj David chi' to hanheja' sayjiek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl chi' yik smilanchamok, ix kanxonhej winh t'a Hores, t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Zif chi'.
Ay jun k'ual ix b'at winhaj Jonatán yil winhaj David t'a Hores chi'. Ix ak'ji stek'anil winhaj David chi' yuj winh yik syak'anoch Dios winh yipok sk'ool.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, yujto manh ol ach ilchajlaj yuj winh in mam chi'. Yujto a ach tik, ol ach ochnhej ko reyalok a onh israel onh tik, a inxo ol in och t'a schab'il yajalil t'ayach. Ha jun tik yojtakxopax winh in mam chi', xchi winh.
Ix snaanxikot strato heb' winh schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a spat, haxo pax winhaj David chi', ix kannhej winh t'a Hores chi'.

Haxo heb' kajan t'a Zif chi' ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Saúl t'a Gabaa, ix yalan heb': --Ha winhaj David, ayek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol ko makb'en, t'a juntzanh k'een nhak'een t'a switzal Haquila, t'a Hores, t'a stojolal sur t'a chonhab' Jesimón.
Yuj chi' mamin rey, tato syal a k'ool tzach b'at ta', syal tzach b'ati, ol ko ch'ox winh t'ayach, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb': --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, yujto tz'ok' he k'ool t'ayin.
Ha tiknaik, swal t'ayex to b'at eyil wal b'ajwaltil ayek' winh, mach ix ilani, yujto swab'i tob' te jelan winh skolan sb'a.

Tzeyil wal sik'lab'il b'aj wal sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh chi', tzul eyalanxi t'ayin t'a sjichanil, icha chi' ol aj in b'at heyet'ok. Tato yel ayek' winh ta', ol b'at in sayek' winh t'a skal masanil yol yik Judá, xchi winh.

Ix b'ab'laj pax heb' aj Zif chi' t'a schonhab', haxo winhaj Saúl chi' tzak'anto ix b'at winh yet' heb' soldado. Haxo pax winhaj David chi', ayek' winh yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok t'a Maón, t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a ak'lik t'a stojolal sur t'a chonhab' Jesimón.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado say winh. Ayik ix alji jun tik t'a winhaj David chi', ix emta winh t'a sattak k'een, ix kannhej winh t'a lum Maón t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Yuj chi' a ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', ix b'at winh sayek' winh ta'.

Ha t'a jun spak'ul jun witz chi', hata' sb'at winhaj Saúl yet' soldado. Haxo t'a junxo spatik lu'um, hata' sb'atpax winhaj David yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok yik syak' yip heb' yel t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta toxo ix oyjichaanh winhaj David yet' heb' ajun yet' winh yuj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado chi' yik syamji heb'.
Elanhchamel ix k'och jun winh chekab' t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, meltzajanh t'a elanhchamel, yujto a heb' filisteo toxo ix och heb' t'a yol ko chonhab', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch waan winh spechan b'eyek' winhaj David chi'. Atax ta' ix skuchkan jun sat k'een chi' icha tik: Sat k'een b'aj ix spoj sb'a b'e.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'atkan winhaj David chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een t'a yol yik En-gadi.
